title: SafeTune: A Unified Faithful Library for Auditing and Repairing Safety Drift in Fine-Tuned LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2609.22153v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Methods for addressing safety drift in fine-tuned Large Language Models (LLMs) are scattered across incompatible implementations, lifecycle stages, and evaluation protocols, making them difficult to adopt and compare. We introduce SafeTune, a source-available library that unifies four intervention paradigms: post-hoc weight recovery, safety-constrained fine-tuning, gradient-based unlearning, and inference-time steering, alongside shared interpretability, evaluation, and deployment utilities. SafeTune provides a consistent configuration-driven workflow while preserving the distinct inputs and intervention points each paradigm requires. Its modular registry supports new methods, benchmarks, judges, models, and fine-tuning domains without redesigning the surrounding pipeline. translated_title: SafeTune：一个用于审计和修复微调大语言模型安全漂移的统一忠实库
translated_abstract: 针对微调大语言模型（LLM）安全漂移（safety drift）的处理方法分散在不兼容的实现方式、生命周期阶段和评估协议之中，导致它们难以被采用和比较。我们推出了 SafeTune，这是一个源代码公开的库，它统一了四种干预范式：事后权重恢复、安全约束微调、基于梯度的遗忘，以及推理时引导，并配套提供共享的可解释性、评估和部署工具。SafeTune 提供了一致的配置驱动式工作流程，同时保留了每种范式所需的独特输入和干预点。其模块化注册表支持添加新方法、基准、评判器、模型和微调领域，而无需重新设计周边流程。我们通过受控比较以及金融和医疗部署案例研究展示了 SafeTune，说明它如何刻画安全漂移、评估可行的干预措施……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: SafeTune 是一个源代码公开的统一库，整合了事后权重恢复、安全约束微调、梯度遗忘和推理时引导四种干预范式，为微调大语言模型的安全漂移提供了一致的审计与修复工作流程。
en_tdlr: SafeTune is a source-available unified library that integrates four intervention paradigms—post-hoc weight recovery, safety-constrained fine-tuning, gradient-based unlearning, and inference-time steering—to consistently audit and repair safety drift in fine-tuned LLMs.
